transcript.text: Hi everyone. I'm considering an informal exchange of my first-pressing vinyl record, and Marcus has mentioned a possible trade involving a used synthesizer. Before I agree to anything, my usual practice is to hear from each person present — please state any relevant offer, comparison, compatibility, or handoff detail you have. If anyone is bringing up an offer from someone who isn't here, I'll record that as your report. Let's hear what everyone's got.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: My exact proposal is my Korg Minilogue XD synthesizer plus $75 in cash for Lena's first-pressing vinyl record, with the exchange on Saturday at 2:00 p.m.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I should let everyone know — Gabe, another collector who isn't here today, told me he would pay exactly $400 cash for the record and could collect it Sunday afternoon. I'm reporting this on his behalf since he isn't present.
